title: Templates: interpolation and property binding
summary: Show class data in a template with {{ }} and set element properties with [property] binding.

docs.title: Angular: Binding dynamic text, properties and attributes

quiz.q: Which template line sets the `disabled` property of a button from a class value called `locked`?
quiz.explain: Square brackets bind a property to an expression. Without them, `disabled="locked"` is just the fixed text 'locked', which an HTML button treats as disabled no matter what.

quiz.q: Bind the image source to the class property `photoUrl`.
quiz.explain: `[src]="photoUrl"` reads `photoUrl` from the class. Plain `src="photoUrl"` would look for a file called photoUrl.

quiz.q: The class has `marks = 70;`. What does this template show?
quiz.explain: Interpolation accepts small expressions, not only names. Angular calculates 70 + 5 and shows 75.

quiz.q: Click the line that will NOT show the student's name.
quiz.explain: Without curly braces `name` is plain text, so the heading shows the word 'name'.
